info.description:
REST API for Cavyro. All endpoints live under `/api/v1`.

## Authentication

Create an API token in the Cavyro app (**Settings → API Tokens**) and send it
as a bearer token on every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your-api-token>
```

Workspace-scoped endpoints additionally require the `X-Workspace-Id` header
identifying the workspace you are acting in.

API tokens expire (7, 30 or 90 days, chosen at creation) and can be revoked at
any time from the app.

## Collections & pagination

Collection endpoints share a common query contract — `page`, `limit`,
`sort`, `direction`, plus per-route filters — and return pagination metadata
in the `page-limit`, `current-page`, `total-count` and `total-pages`
response headers.

## Errors

Errors use a consistent envelope:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "<machine_code>",
    "message": "<human message>",
    "details": {},
    "request_id": "<request id>"
  }
}
```

`code` is stable — branch on it, never on `message`. `details` is present
only when there is structured context (field errors, limits). Quote
`request_id` when contacting support.

## Webhooks

Subscribe to domain events (deals, contacts, companies) via
`POST /api/v1/webhook_subscriptions` — payloads, headers and the signature
scheme are documented in the **Webhooks** section below.

post.description:
A new meeting appeared on a connected Google Calendar.

Configure receivers via `POST /api/v1/webhook_subscriptions`. Each delivery is an
HTTP POST with headers:

- `X-Cavyro-Event` — the event type
- `X-Cavyro-Signature` — `sha256=<hex>`, the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body
  keyed with the subscription's `secret`; verify it before trusting the payload.

Respond with any 2xx status to acknowledge. Failed deliveries are retried with
backoff; other subscriptions are unaffected.

200.description: Return any 2xx status to acknowledge receipt.

WebhookEvent.description: Envelope delivered to webhook subscription URLs.

changes.description: Field delta for update-flavored events, shaped {"field": [from, to]}. Empty for lifecycle events.

data.description: The affected resource (deal, contact, company, campaign or meeting) with the same attributes the REST API returns.

event.description: Event type. The full list is served by GET /api/v1/webhook_event_types.

meta.description: Event-specific context: the tag on *.tag_added/removed, the campaign on campaign.replied, recipient stats on campaign.completed. Empty elsewhere.

bearerAuth.description: API token created in the Cavyro app (Settings → API Tokens).
